signals: The 2026-06-04 audit is fully executed; this plan deliberately builds on the shipped Almanac, Sundial Queue, Legacy Vows, Director Memory, Myth So Far, and Last Light links.
SUPABASE_DB_URL remains the only production-scale blocker, so the highest-value agent work is to make the backend contract more explicit and the offline path more trustworthy.
App.jsx is still large, but the safest June 7 pass is small reusable modules plus thin UI/export wiring rather than a broad split.
Every item preserves the deterministic zero-browser-token policy and keeps free-tier cost neutral.

items.title: RPC Contract Manifest - make backend hardening verifiable before the secret lands
items.why: The current verifier proves public reads and two hardened RPCs, but Solara now depends on five write contracts: grave, score, echo, reaction, and offering. A shared manifest turns the Supabase blocker from a vague secret gap into a crisp deploy checklist, and it keeps runtime, docs, tests, and public status aligned when the database finally comes online.
items.recipe: Add a reusable backend contract manifest for required tables/RPCs, make scripts/verify-supabase-hardening.mjs consume it, export the manifest summary through public chronicle/status contracts, and add tests that all queued write kinds have a matching RPC contract.

items.title: Sundial Queue Briefing - show exactly what offline light is waiting to sync
items.why: The queue is already a strong offline-first invention, but its summary is still too coarse for a player deciding whether their run mattered. A grouped briefing by record kind, oldest age, and next sync condition makes the pending chronicle feel intentional instead of hidden technical debt.
items.recipe: Extend src/game/sundialQueue.js with a public-safe briefing object, surface it in the Daily Rite queue card and chronicle export, and test grouping, caps, and no-secret/no-HTML output.

items.title: Rite Pacing Coach - turn the Director route plan into mid-run decisions
items.why: Daily Rite route segments are now deterministic, but most of their value appears before the run starts. A pacing coach that reads current wave, vow, challenge target, and Director segment can tell the player when to bank, push, or hunt a rival, making the run feel authored minute by minute with no AI spend.
items.recipe: Add src/game/riteCoach.js, wire it into run start/debrief copy, and test segment selection, vow/challenge pressure, and deterministic guidance.

items.title: Last Light Result Card - make every Daily Rite shareable without a screenshot
items.why: Challenge links let a friend replay the route, but the current share artifact is still just a URL. A compact deterministic result card gives players a Wordle-like social object: wave, vow result, challenge comparison, phase, and one line of myth, all sanitized and copied as text.
items.recipe: Add src/game/resultCard.js, use it in the completed Daily Rite copy action, export the latest shape through chronicle contracts, and test sanitization plus stable formatting.

items.title: Outcome Receipt Queue Link - connect pending writes to the zero-token intelligence layer
items.why: Outcome receipts currently summarize world signals, but they do not acknowledge records sealed in the Sundial Queue. Adding a queue receipt closes the feedback loop: the player sees that an offline grave, score, or offering is already part of the deterministic intelligence surface even before Supabase accepts it.
items.recipe: Update outcome receipt generation to include a queue_pending receipt when a queue briefing is present; export it through chronicle/status and test token cost remains zero.

items.title: App Surface Smoke Contract - stop regressions in the newly modular Daily Rite surface
items.why: The biggest risk after the June 4 tranche is not missing code, it is UI drift: imported modules can pass unit tests while App.jsx stops exposing them coherently. A smoke contract that asserts the app still references the World Feed, Almanac, Myth So Far, Vow picker, queue card, challenge copy, and new result-card/coach surfaces gives the next extraction pass a tripwire.
items.recipe: Extend scripts/smoke-runtime.mjs or add a focused test to scan the transformed app surface for the required Daily Rite integration markers; include the new modules in the contract.

skipped.reason: Still depends on SUPABASE_DB_URL or owner dashboard credentials. The audit keeps this visible but does not relabel it as agent-shippable without the credential.
The current risk profile favors small module extraction and smoke contracts before another broad UI surgery pass.
Blocked by CANON-029 free-tier cost discipline; deterministic narrative generation remains the correct path.

executionLog.evidence: src/game/backendContract.js now defines the shared-world table/RPC contract for grave, daily_score, echo, reaction, and offering writes; scripts/verify-supabase-hardening.mjs consumes the manifest; chronicle/status exports include backend_contract. tests/june7-systems.test.mjs verifies every Sundial Queue kind has a matching RPC contract.

src/game/sundialQueue.js exports getSundialQueueBriefing() with grouped public-safe counts, oldest age, next-sync copy, and cap data; App.jsx surfaces the briefing in the Daily Rite queue card; chronicle/status exports include shared_world.sundial_queue.

src/game/riteCoach.js maps Daily Rite route segment, wave, vow, and challenge pressure into deterministic mid-run guidance; App.jsx announces the coach at run start, shows it while the run is active, and stores final coach guidance on debrief.

src/game/resultCard.js builds a sanitized deterministic Last Light result card; App.jsx uses it for completed/failed Daily Rite share cards; chronicle exports result_card_shape for integration consumers.
src/game/outcomeReceipts.js emits queue_pending receipts when a queue briefing has sealed records. Tests verify the new receipt keeps token_cost at zero.

scripts/smoke-runtime.mjs now exports and asserts Sun Almanac, Myth So Far, Legacy Vows, Daily Rite route plan, Sundial Queue briefing, world feed, first-session plan, save, and import surfaces. npm run smoke passes.
